referenceFidelity.findings: User explicitly requested much more dimension after rejecting r8. New 3.1077m depth versus 2.24m (+39%) intentionally exaggerates volume beyond the turnaround. Preserves three-tier cream crown, cyan eyes, diagonal cheeks, orange clasps and left blueprint module. Side profile now bows forward and rearward; side casing has convex central facets.

construction.findings: Solid thick cheeks and convex fitted side patches replace the previous shallow surfaces. Close oblique inspection shows a deep continuous visor well. Final liner is offset from cream to avoid coplanar flicker and extends behind display into the body to close the side gap. Final audit: 2012 triangles, zero degenerate triangles, 2 materials and one packed palette; technical report has no errors or warnings.

readability.findings: Actual Inspector front/side/isometric comparison and phone view retain eye separation, stepped crown and strong cheek frame. Deep face and convex casing remain visible at phone scale; small blueprint windows remain secondary.

motion.findings: Model refinement only. Animation remains deferred following user shape feedback; no clips authored.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked final r15 side silhouette, close oblique and phone after repairs. The previous coplanar cream/dark liner artifacts are gone. The open wedge between jaw and shell is filled by a physical liner; only the deliberate shallow lower jaw/body step remains. Deeper primary masses and face recess read clearly.

evidence.view: front, side and iso vs rejected r8

userAcceptance.note: User rejects the current design direction as no longer reflecting an application architect and explicitly requests creative skeptical review and re-imagination. The browser had a prior revision of this same direction; feedback supersedes the working direction.

limitations: Depth deliberately exceeds the original concept proportions in response to explicit user feedback.
